book_info.title: Pip the Brave Little Penguin
book_info.subtitle: An Antarctic Adventure
book_info.moral: Being brave doesn't mean not being scared—it means trying anyway

art_style.lighting: bright Antarctic daylight, warm golden sunrise/sunset
art_style.texture: soft watercolor washes, snowy textures, gentle ice sparkles

pip.name: Pip
pip.description: A small, fluffy Emperor penguin chick with soft grey downy feathers on the body, a white belly, and a black head with distinctive yellow-orange patches on the sides of the neck. Big round dark eyes full of expression, small flippers, and little webbed feet. Noticeably smaller than the other penguins.
pip.personality: nervous but determined, kind-hearted, wants to be brave
pip.distinguishing_features: A small tuft of fluffy down that sticks up on top of head, making Pip easy to identify

mama_penguin.name: Mama
mama_penguin.description: A tall, elegant adult Emperor penguin with sleek black and white feathers and bright golden-yellow patches on the sides of her neck. Kind, warm eyes. She looks protective and loving.

otto.name: Otto
otto.description: A friendly brown sea otter with a round face, whiskers, small ears, and a lighter brown chest. Playful expression, often floating on his back.

settings.penguin_colony: A large group of Emperor penguins on Antarctic ice, with snowy mountains in the background, clear blue sky
settings.ice_cliff: A tall ice cliff overlooking the deep blue Antarctic ocean, with smaller ice formations around
settings.underwater: Crystal clear blue Antarctic water with shafts of light, fish swimming, ice formations visible above
settings.sunset_ice: Golden and orange sunset light reflecting off ice and snow, creating warm glows
